messages:
Emma (Marketing): Plan is to publish the release post + changelog tomorrow 10:00am PT. Need docs permalink, a one-line bench stat, and webinar/reg link by EOD today.

Kai (Eng): OK. Propose canary freeze at 8:00am PT so rollout doesn't collide with publish. There's a tiny batching edge-case note I'll add to migration guide.

Liam (Product): No breaking API changes for normal flows. User-visible: smarter routing for short sessions -> better p95. I'll draft the product blurb.

Sophia (Docs): Draft changelog page uploaded: https://redwood.inference/docs/changelog/v4-preview
I can add a short migration note once Kai posts the wording.

Noah (Release Manager): We need final permalink for the pipeline by 6pm PT. Site deploy job requires it.

Aria (Marketing Ops): Webinar: 11:00am PT tomorrow, 30min. Need an Eng co-presenter for ~8-10 mins. Kai, can you do 11:00-11:10?

Kai (Eng): Yes for 11:00-11:10. I'll prepare a 2-slide micro-benchmark and export a PNG for assets.

Emma (Marketing): Bench copy check: can we say "up to 35% lower p95 for short-chat workloads"?

Kai (Eng): 35% is optimistic in lab for <48 tokens. Recommend conservative: "up to ~30%".

Liam (Product): +1 to ~30%. Marketing phrasing: "up to ~30% lower p95 latency on short-chat workloads (internal benchmark)."

Sophia (Docs): Changelog snippet draft:
```
## v4.0 — Routing + cache improvements (2026-06-02)
- Adaptive routing for short-session traffic
- KV prefix cache improvements to lower redundant compute
- Fix: stable quantization fallback for mixed-precision paths
```

Emma (Marketing): Perfect. Once the docs permalink is live drop it here so I can link from the blog and threads.

release-bot: scheduled_deploy: docs-site job 12021 — ETA ~10m

Noah (Release Manager): If deploy is green we'll target 9:30am PT to merge the blog draft so marketing can QA before 10:00am publish.

Aria (Marketing Ops): Webinar reg link will be live by 9:00am PT tomorrow. Recording + auto-upload confirmed.

Kai (Eng): I'll upload benchmark PNG to /drive/marketing/assets by 5:00pm PT. Caption will read: "Internal benchmark — 95th percentile latency — short sessions".

Sophia (Docs): Docs PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/512 — includes migration note and prelink.

Noah (Release Manager): Deploy finished: docs-site job 12021 — SUCCESS. Changelog live at https://redwood.inference/docs/changelog/v4.0

Emma (Marketing): Got the permalink. I'll merge blog at 9:30am PT for final QA and publish 10:00am PT. Social assets go out after 10:05.

Aria (Marketing Ops): Webinar reg: https://events.redwood.ai/webinar/2026-06-routing-cache. Co-presenter: Kai confirmed. Slides owned by Emma.

Kai (Eng): Good luck everyone. Ping me during the webinar channel if live questions pop up.
